name: cpython-security-toolkit
description: Security invariant analysis for CPython's standard library — finding semantic security flaws that generic SAST tools, fuzzers, and sanitizers do not model well.
author: ReviewToolkits

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Full security scan using all four engines (archive, protocol, resource, audit)

commands.name: archive
commands.description: Archive extraction boundary analysis — tarfile, zipfile, shutil

commands.name: protocol
commands.description: Protocol validation coverage analysis — incomplete-fix detection

commands.name: resource
commands.description: Resource amplification analysis — decompression bounds, algorithmic complexity

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Audit hook coverage analysis — sys.audit() gaps, command injection

commands.name: reproduce
commands.description: Generate and validate a reproducer for a specific finding ID
